'''Yamamoto Hachiman Shrine''' (山本八幡宮, Yamamoto Hachimangū) is a [[shrine]] located in Fujinomiya, Shizuoka Prefecture. It is also referred to as '''Tōdō Hachiman Shrine''' (多田八幡宮). Under the [[Modern shrine Ranking system]], it was classified as a Village Shrine.

== Origins ==
According to tradition, the shrine was established when Yoshino Sadatomi, the great-grandfather of Yamamoto Kansuke, enshrined the deity.
